assumptions: All geometry ranges are proposed trial settings, not measured sample parameters or optimum thicknesses.
Normal incidence, monochromatic coherent plane wave, undepleted fundamental field, flat infinite lateral layers.
Upper Nb b/c axes define laboratory x/y; z points from air into the substrate.
Lower b=(cos(theta),sin(theta)); c=(-sin(theta),cos(theta)). Angles are directed, not reduced modulo 180 degrees.
Both Nb flakes use historical nb_reflection optical constants; their original independent measurement provenance is missing.
Both Nb tensors equal [1,0,0] in relative units. Equality, phases and the zero secondary components are baseline assumptions, not calibrated 1064-nm tensor values.
hBN basal normal is assumed parallel to z; its transverse index is isotropic and transparent. The Lee formula is a literature candidate, not a measurement of the new sample.
hBN, all interfaces and substrate nonlinear sources are omitted in this baseline. This does not establish that their experimental SHG is zero.
No electronic interlayer coupling, excitonic coupling, strain relaxation, finite NA or instrument Jones matrix is modeled.
Cplus/Cminus mean (1,+i)/sqrt(2) and (1,-i)/sqrt(2), with exp(-i omega t). They are not calibrated experimental L/R labels.
Q uses one fixed bare 75.4-nm Nb reference with X-linear fundamental light; it is not counts or conversion efficiency.
Candidate thresholds and sensitivity offsets are deterministic analysis settings, not experimental detection limits, error bars or confidence intervals.
